tagline: A quote or a photo, rendered for e-paper, new one every hour or tap
description: Turns the device into a picture frame. Quote mode typesets one of twenty public-domain quotes as a full-screen card; image mode fetches a PNG or JPEG from a URL you set, crops it to the screen and dithers it to sixteen greys. The card changes every hour; tap the right half for the next one, the left half for the previous. Rendering happens on a Cloudflare Worker (satori + resvg) and is cached per card.

changelog.notes: First release: quote and image modes, hourly rotation, prev/next tap zones, per-seed cache.
